title: cli + READMEs: `objectui generate page` and the core/runner READMEs write a titled page node with no `pageType`, so it draws as a record page with no heading (rest of objectui#11436's family)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect family. This card carries the half that objectui#11436 leaves: the producers under `packages/`, outside the `content/docs/**` + `examples/**` population triage ruled for that card. objectui#11436 keeps the docs and examples and lands them in PR objectui#11449.

`reach:` named real producers, read by the seat on `origin/main` (2026-10-02):
- **The CLI generator.** `objectui generate page NAME` is wired at `packages/cli/src/cli.ts:150`. It runs `generatePage` in `packages/cli/src/commands/generate.ts:57`, which writes `{ type: "page", title: name, children: [...] }` with no `pageType` (lines 70–72). `@object-ui/cli` 17.6.0 ships it in `dist`.
- **Two published READMEs.** `packages/core/README.md:37–41` teaches the `PageNodeSchema` literal `{ type: 'page', title: 'My Page', children: [] }`. `packages/runner/README.md:128–130` teaches an Example Schema `{ "type": "page", "title": "Dashboard", ... }`. Both READMEs ship through the `files[]` of `@object-ui/core` and `@object-ui/runner` 17.6.0.
- **The defect is objectui#11436's.** The page renderer resolves `pageType || 'record'`, and a record page does not draw `title` (or `description`) as a heading. The objectui#11436 dev rendered 15 producers of exactly this shape through the real `SchemaRenderer` at PR objectui#11449's head `727873f0d`, and none drew an `h1` (dev report `5946554036`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]` and `[1]`). The seat read the code and did not re-run that probe.

Reader who acts: triage first (grade, and route `packages/cli` plus the two READMEs to a lane), then that lane's seat. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37`). ⛔ Not graded here.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)
- objectui#11436's fix, applied here: each producer authors the `pageType` it means. PR objectui#11449 uses `"app"` for a standalone page.
- The generator is released source. It needs a changeset and a CLI unit test asserting that the generated document carries a `pageType` under which its `title` draws.
- Extend the enumeration pin PR objectui#11449 adds (`packages/components/src/__tests__/page-node-headings-drawn-11436.test.tsx`) to `packages/*/README.md` fences and the generator's output, so the whole family stays closed by enumeration rather than by memory.
- Noted, for the implementer: `packages/runner/src/App.tsx` builds a fallback welcome page of the same shape. The dev found it dead (that path also sets an error, and the error branch renders instead). Fix it or delete it, and say which in the PR.

## Dedupe
The 814 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (back to #3162, REST, grepped locally 2026-10-02):
- `generatePage|generate page|objectui generate` 2: PR objectui#11449 (this family) and open PR objectui#11069 (objectui#5250 slice A). objectui#11069 lists the `objectui generate page` output as valid on the strict face. That is a validity reading, not the heading defect.
- README near `pageType` 1: objectui#11440, which is about the plugin-detail README's `detail-section` node, not this.
- `generate.ts` 1: PR objectui#11449.

None covers the generator or the two READMEs.

Dedupe words: `objectui generate page pageType` · `generatePage title not drawn` · `README page node pageType title` · `core README PageNodeSchema title record page` · `runner README Example Schema page heading`
